title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Component Datasheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Palette stays pinned to your brief: charcoal ground, warm white ink, one restrained accent.

options.label: Component Datasheet
options.lineage: semiconductor datasheets: block diagrams, characteristic tables, absolute maximum ratings
options.thesis: The portfolio reads like a part's datasheet: what it does, how it is wired, how it was tested, where it fails.
options.viewport: Name set wide across the top like a part number, one-line function statement, and a live block diagram of TND's pipeline owning the right two-thirds; three actions in a ruled strip below.
options.risk: Tables everywhere would read cold to a recruiter; prose must lead and tables carry only real specs.

raised.raise: No colour carries state: implemented, partial and planned are drawn as solid, cross-ticked and gapped lines, always with a text label.
Vast unprinted ground: one figure owns each section, everything else stays quiet.
System states print themselves: TND's DEGRADED reasons appear as set text, never as chrome.

options.label: Evidence Exhibit File
options.lineage: case files with tagged exhibits and claim-by-claim findings
options.thesis: Each claim on the site is filed with the exhibit that supports it.
options.viewport: A claim headline with its exhibit tag pinned beside it, linking to the code or test that proves it.
options.risk: Mirrors TND's own subject so literally that it can read as a costume of the project.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every item tied to its default by a line whose stroke shows its state.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes with link rails; the portfolio as a configuration schedule.
options.risk: A recruiter reads it as a settings screen, not a person.
options.case: Loses both axes: audience does not identify with patch bays; clarity drops.
options.kept: State drawn by stroke pattern, never colour alone.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Everything is a numbered catalog entry under a single plot.
options.viewport: A pulse plot and a fac number; the name decoded on hover.
options.risk: Hiding the name defeats a recruiter's 30-second read.
options.case: Loses both axes: coded labels obscure who and what.
options.kept: Restraint: one figure owns the field.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The site as a live transcript.
options.viewport: One scrolling transcript in a bitmap mono.
options.risk: Your brief bans fake terminals and neon.

options.label: Racing League
options.viewport: A liveried craft carrying the name.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.thesis: Work told as framed tile panels.
options.viewport: A narrative panel over the doorway.
options.risk: Cobalt on white breaks the pinned dark palette.
options.kept: Layout snaps to whole grid units.

options.label: Rain-night City
options.thesis: A city of lights as the map of the work.
options.risk: Atmosphere over information; heavy to render.
options.kept: Bands that stay synchronised across breakpoints.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark developer portfolio: hero, project cards, skills, contact, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and headline left, screenshot right, cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most student portfolios by design.
